correctness.rationale: I verified M=b^n-1,N=b^m-1 and their gcd reduces (U,Y) to (uZ,vZ), where u,v are coprime. Conditional on Y=y, the v inverse branches of z↦vz are equiprobable; early phases permute a shifted v-grid. Counting grid points in any wrapping or nonwrapping arc produces q=floor(vL) plus a single translated residual interval J of length θ={vL}; normalizing by P(U∈I)=L yields the two-level conditional density. The positive part has integral θ(1-θ)/(vL), and the zero-mean signed primitive has oscillation θ(1-θ)/(uvL), establishing the sharp Borel TV and connected-arc suprema, respectively. Density Haar iff θ=0. Independently checked rational examples (u,v)=(3,7),(1,13),(1,5) including exact resonance; packaged checker independently pushes intervals and reports 914 exact rational cases. Finite checks corroborate the complete direct grid proof.
